svg.title: Sign your commits with GPG for the Verified badge (and why GitHub still says Unverified)
svg.desc: a GPG key ring with a visible gap in its seal, a commit arrow passing through, and a second broken signature line that fails to close, all inside a GitHub-style verified check frame. Trace Bloom generative banner for “Sign your commits with GPG for the Verified badge (and why GitHub still says Unverified)”. A isometric lattice probed by 4 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Seed 3714885367.
